comments.text: Maupiti’s greatest wealth may be the very thing that conventional economics struggles to measure: control over its own future. comments.author: @rock3times
comments.text:
just come back from maupiti..
the island has only one papahani considered resort, the rest are locals rent out one of their rooms..Electricity is only avalaible from 7-9am and 5-9 pm by house rule, generator runs on gasoline and expensive..toilet use outside stated hours must evacuate using bucket dumping water because water pump run on electricity as well..
plenty fresh water to drink and cook..shower must be during hours..
the visit is not for convenience rather more than an adventure..
people are very friendly
advise not to fly because frequent cancellation will screw up your itinerary..rather take the ferry Apetahi Express twice a week  from papeete to bora bora then maupiti, the westernmost point of French Polynesia..
